By 17 she kicked me out and called the police saying I ran away. But little did she know the message she sent my friend would prove otherwise. After that I went to go live with my grandparents.

21, I started working in the night life. Not only that but I began hanging out with people who were no good for me. Literally walking in hell trying to survive. No where to stay at times. Slept in my car or at a hotel. But somehow I managed.

18-20 I started to feel like my life was giving me a break, I was in college, I didn’t have much stress. But I was blinded by a few misleading things and heartbreak that led me back into depression and I dropped out of college... I only had 1 year left....

22 was my worst year, no doubt lol. I ran into the law 4 times. Got locked up 4 times. But my guardian angels must’ve been working hard, bc each case I caught could’ve been worse than what I got charged with.

Anyways, I spent a week in jail; and in that week I realized who was really for me and who was really not. I knew that if I didn’t change my ways, this is what my future was going to be. after swallowing my pride and calling my mom, she bailed me out the next day.

After that, I decided to do things differently, I got out the night life. And to be honest, that was the best decision I did for myself. Because I could’ve lost my life after that crash, or I could’ve been charged with a DUI/DWI but I didn’t. S/O to my Angels.
23, he proposed, months later we got married. Then I got pregnant. By the end of 2017, we had our own apartment that we got on our own. We both had great jobs where we were making great money.
